title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode7 Operation: Detain Dylan!

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hey, that girl looks really familiar for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Yeah, isn't she an idol or something...?
Why's she chasing Dylan around?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
Minori, I think your cover's been blown.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's okay... Well, not really...
But I'm Minori Hanasato the zookeeper right now, so I need to focus on catching Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
It's a dead end!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
You're trapped like a rat now, my armadillo friend!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Huff*
We're not letting you get away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry.
We won't hurt you, so just stay still for us and—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, he's making a run for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika, twelve o'clock!
Block his path!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just barely... We almost had him.
He's a slippery one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was incredible... It had such a rough texture...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still not the right time to be gushing over him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've been running around for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think we've gone around the entire zoo now. Look, we're back in the Grassland Area...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Schubert seems to be pointing his cold gaze towards us for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if he's making fun of us for not catching Dylan sooner...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I thought you two were friends now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you able to call the staff over?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was.
They're bringing over nets and other gear, so they should be able to catch—

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line:
Take this part of the net!
No, not that part! This part...!

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line:
No, Dylan!
Don't go that way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's going straight towards you, Minori...!
This might be your chance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You can do it!
You'll block his path if you time it right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right. If I have Luka assisting me, then I might actually be able to...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<He's still too far.
Just a little bit closer and...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
He really is a slippery one...
We should probably get more staff to—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The noise stopped Dylan in his tracks...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You did it, Shiho!!
That was amazing!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Cool! That girl who was chasing after him actually caught him!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
That was incredible!
She really caught that feisty little armadillo!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't deserve all the credit.
I mean, that sudden sound helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that sound just now did stun Dylan long enough for you to catch him.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What even was that...?
It was so loud...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Ah, that was Schubert clattering his beak.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Remember when I mentioned earlier that Schubert shows his affection in other ways besides bowing?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: The sound he made just now is one of them. Shoebills don't have many calls per se, but they clatter their beaks as a way of greeting others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As a way of greeting others...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean he was greeting you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you friends with him?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I was under that impression...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you were greeting me, Schubert, then thanks!! We were able to catch Dylan because you did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow...
You two must be really close now.
